scope: Failure-only diagnostic observation for the unexplained IHFR404 in phase7 v2; not a root-cause fix or official CI result.
observed_contracts: Three GET requests retain the initial auth cookie even when /me sends an expiration response; input cookie remains unchanged.
Raw synthetic private fields and unrecognized error strings do not escape; output maps unknown code to OTHER.
HTML404 and redirect302 remain distinguishable and redirects are not followed.
Invalid origin, path or unowned schema causes a skip before any request.
unchanged: No production source, scientific algorithm, schema, fixture setup, readiness, existing test action or assertion changed.
No retries added and no existing test timeout, viewport or scale changed.
A failed gate remains failed; observations run only after an unexpected test failure containing a404.
limits: The probes are after-failure observations; they do not reconstruct the earlier request or prove the server selected schema.
The cache hypothesis is inconclusive; no populated persistent cache was obtained in the limited synthetic restart experiment.
No diagnostic probe outcome from the official Windows app has been observed yet.
False presence booleans mean not observed in that response, not proof of resource absence; probes use current cookies after failure and the last404 navigation context.
review: Independent readonly review found no material security defect; diagnostic context now tracks the last404 navigation rather than the final page URL.
